title: Universal Stud

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Can be used as building and can be dyed

body:
"Wow, the universable part of surfaces. Impressive, i love gifts!"

The Universal Stud is an item unboxed from the Gift Of Universal Surfaces.


Description

The Universal Stud is a 1x1x1 stud brick with either a stud or an inlet on each surface.

Trivia

  • The Universal Stud has 720 possible surface combinations.
